new_commodity_proposals.evidence: Not priced under any other spelling: it is not sour cream (different fat, salt and price class, sold in a squeeze bottle), not heavy-cream, and not creme fraiche. Board reports no commodity and no capture match, so a null would pantry-price 600 g of dairy in the sauce.

Also sold as queso quesadilla/asadero; it is not the bagged shredded-cheese blend the board fuzzy-matched, nor mozzarella-cheese (different make and price class). Check the Hispanic cheese case labels for 'Chihuahua' and 'quesadilla' before minting, in case an asadero id already exists.

registrar_rulings.reason: No price cell in smp-feed and no id/label/include across the three namespaces carries crema; the only 'crema' strings in the estate are creme-fraiche's OWN excludes ('crema mexicana/salvadoreña', commodities.json:67647/67735), i.e. a prior human ruling already carved crema OUT of creme-fraiche, and sour-cream/light-sour-cream (both priced) neither match nor exclude it. Crema mexicana is a distinct purchase class from sour-cream (pourable, saltier, higher fat, different shelf price) - a legitimate variant, not a spelling of an existing row. FOLLOW-UPS: mint in the recipe-only namespace (recipe-board baseline + recipe-commodities.json); include patterns must cover 'crema mexicana', 'mexican(?:-style)? crema', 'table cream'; build ~150-pattern excludes off a dairy neighbor (must reject sour cream, creme fraiche, media crema/evaporated, coffee creamer); add commodity-dupe-allowlist pairs mexican-crema<->sour-cream and mexican-crema<->creme-fraiche with reason 'different make/fat/salt/price class, deliberately excluded from creme-fraiche' so the daily audit never re-flags them.

No chihuahua/asadero/oaxaca/quesadilla string exists anywhere in the three namespaces or the floor map (verified per file), and the id is unpriced in the feed; the existing 'queso' id is the cheese DIP, not this cheese. It is a distinct cheese type, not a brand - the estate already mints specific cheeses (gruyere, feta, parmesan) alongside the generic shredded-cheese board id, and extending Brad's mozzarella-cheese->shredded-cheese floor-map alias to a new cheese is a human pricing verification I cannot make for him (near names never auto-match, ruled 2026-08-26). HAZARD FOUND: shredded-cheese's include 'shredded\s+\w+(?:\s+\w+)?\s+cheese' WILL claim 'Shredded Chihuahua Cheese' products and its 115 excludes contain no Mexican-cheese pattern, so this approval is conditional on the follow-ups shipping together: (1) add excludes for chihuahua|quesadilla|asadero|oaxaca to shredded-cheese via add-commodity-rule.ps1; (2) mint in the recipe-only namespace with includes covering 'chihuahua', 'queso quesadilla', 'asadero' (contiguous phrases that survive in real product names) and excludes rejecting dips ('con queso', 'dip') and tortillas/quesadilla kits; (3) add allowlist pairs chihuahua-cheese<->shredded-cheese and chihuahua-cheese<->queso with reasons ('specialty melting cheese vs generic blend, different price class' / 'cheese vs dip').
